mapper.select: select a.*, m.nick_name, m.avatar_url from mall_runner_application a left join mall_member m on m.member_id = a.member_id where a.member_id = #{memberId}
select a.*, m.nick_name, m.avatar_url from mall_runner_application a left join mall_member m on m.member_id = a.member_id where a.app_id = #{appId}

select a.*, m.nick_name, m.avatar_url from mall_runner_application a left join mall_member m on m.member_id = a.member_id
AND a.status = #{status} AND a.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%')
order by a.apply_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_runner_application (member_id, real_name, id_number, phone, id_photo_url, status, apply_time) values (#{memberId}, #{realName}, #{idNumber}, #{phone}, #{idPhotoUrl}, '0', #{applyTime}) on duplicate key update real_name = values(real_name), id_number = values(id_number), phone = values(phone), id_photo_url = values(id_photo_url), status = '0', reject_reason = null, apply_time = values(apply_time)
